I took my kitten Titi, who was 45 days old, because she wasn't eating and I noticed she had a fever. Toninho measured her temperature and it was 40 degrees Celsius (104 degrees Fahrenheit), he gave her medication, and I went to work.
At lunchtime, I went to visit her, and he force-fed her. When I got to the kennel and played with her, Titi came to eat on her own.
Toninho realized that she had actually had an episode of separation anxiety.
That night, when I went back to see her, Toninho said it was best to take her home, and so I did.
The next day I returned with her to the clinic to continue with the medication.
IF IT WERE AT ANOTHER CLINIC, THEY WOULD HAVE ADMITTED MY LITTLE ONE, DONE BLOOD TESTS, AND MADE HER EVEN MORE STRESSED.

What I love about Toninho's clinic is his sensitivity and the ability to visit whenever I want, and his understanding that my Titi didn't need to be hospitalized, but that she needed to be with me.
